svg.text: sun4v-qemu-kit: OpenBoot PROM build flow – for openboot.bin
Native and cross toolchains, one build chain, the same SPARC Forth code
both paths: e1000 (2), IDE, MD-iodevice guard
Sun: Sun's makefiles, /usr/ccs/bin/make + Sun Studio cc, native:
the Forth engine, makedi, makeprom, didepend
GNU: build-obp.sh cross-builds forth32 (-m32), forth64, makedi, makeprom
for SPARC (run under qemu-user); didepend with the host gcc
experimental, not part of make all
cforth + ~160 lines of Forth run Sun’s metacompiler
and write kernel-xref.dic: forth.dic is not read
